title: Security assistant

intro.title: Ask anything about security
intro.description: Passwords, two-step verification, breaches, suspicious e-mails… It gives general advice: it cannot see your vault or your passwords.

suggestions.title: To get started
suggestions.leak: What should I do if one of my passwords appears in a breach?
suggestions.memorable: How do I create a strong password I can remember?
suggestions.twoFactor: What is two-step verification and when should I turn it on?
suggestions.phishing: How do I spot an e-mail that is trying to steal my password?

reminder: Do not paste passwords or codes here: the assistant does not need them.
memory: The conversation only exists in the memory of this device and is erased when the vault locks.

clear.title: Clear the conversation?
clear.message: It is not saved anywhere: it cannot be brought back.

remaining.zero: You have no questions left today. The daily limit renews at midnight (UTC).
remaining.one: You have {count} question left today. The daily limit renews at midnight (UTC).
remaining.other: You have {count} questions left today. The daily limit renews at midnight (UTC).

quota.exceededTitle: You have reached today’s question limit
quota.exceeded: Every account has a number of questions per day. You can ask again tomorrow.
quota.exceededIn: Every account has a number of questions per day. You can ask again in {time}.

disabled.title: The assistant is turned off
disabled.description: You switched it off in Preferences. While it stays off, AccioPass sends nothing to the AI.

unavailable.title: The assistant is not available right now
unavailable.description: This server does not have the AI running at the moment. The generator, the action plan and the breach check work without it.

offline: The assistant needs a connection. Your conversation stays here for when it is back.
